config.sqlTemplate:
SELECT
    ServiceName, 
  ResourceAttributes['deployment.environment'] as env,
    arrayElement(SpanAttributes, 'error_group_id') AS ErrorGroupID,
    argMax(StatusMessage, Timestamp) ErrorMessage,
    count() AS OccurrenceCount,
    max(Timestamp) AS LastSeen
FROM default.otel_traces
WHERE
    Timestamp >= fromUnixTimestamp64Milli({startDateMilliseconds:Int64})
    AND Timestamp <= fromUnixTimestamp64Milli({endDateMilliseconds:Int64})
    AND arrayElement(SpanAttributes, 'error_group_id') != ''
    AND $__filters
GROUP BY 
    ServiceName, 
  env, ErrorGroupID
ORDER BY OccurrenceCount DESC
config.name: Error Trace (Group By)
